answer: In an attestation graph, trust propagates along bounded-length random walks. A sybil cluster with sparse boundary has low conductance, φ(S)=cut(S,¬S)/vol(S); for a volume-conditioned walk, the probability of escaping within L steps is at most Lφ(S). This min-cut bottleneck limits trusted reach and thus aggregate voting weight, regardless of internal sybil links. pearl, atlas, and garden are merely example node labels, not sources of trust.
